items.title: Unrestricted upload of a file with dangerous type vulnerability (PolyShell)
items.summary: An unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Attackers are actively leveraging this to breach hundreds of e-commerce stores.

items.title: Unchecked return value vulnerability in Google Brotli
items.summary: An unchecked return value vulnerability in Google Brotli that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt memory, disclose sensitive contents, cause denial-of-service, or potentially execute arbitrary code. Exploit traffic has been recorded in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated RCE and customer account takeover (SessionReaper)
items.summary: A critical flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution and customer account takeover. Despite an emergency patch in September 2025, active exploitation has been observed since October 22, 2026, with attackers uploading PHP backdoors.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including critical flaws like CVE-2026-103849 (CVSS 10.0, arbitrary code execution without authentication) and CVE-2026-92909 (CVSS 9.8, incorrect authorization leading to arbitrary code execution in B2B).

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0, Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine) that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.
